| invariant (line) | check (smoke.mjs line) |
|---|---|
| The library renders, and it renders quietly (101) | __vs is present and the library rendered (391); the page loads with no console errors (385) |
| The seven default shelves are the seven default shelves (110) | — no check named in the section |
| A shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (117) | a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (404) |
| Every note has at least one address (130) | every note reachable from the vault is on at least one shelf (417) |
| A book opens on its oldest note (138) | date contents default to oldest and saved newest settings remain readable (483) |
| Notes sharing a date read A-Z, in both directions (147) | notes sharing a date list A-Z in both reading directions (502) |
| A note with no date of its own (170) | a note with no date of its own takes the earliest stamp the file has (585) |
| Undated is a book, not a guess (184) | an undated note lands in Undated, not in a guessed year (430) |
| The ISO week keeps its week-year (199) | an ISO week keeps its week-year across a January boundary (622) |
| The Encyclopedia opens with 0-9 (208) | the Encyclopedia opens with a 0-9 volume, not ten one-note books (638) |
| Plaques are date-only and asked for (216) | year plaques only appear on date classifiers, and only when asked for (649); a plaque sits under the books it names, in the same scroller (666); years group under decade plaques, and a run that wraps is named on both rows (1136) |
| A plaque opens its run (262) | a ribbon left in a plaque-book re-resolves after a rebuild, and the Reading shelf holds it (768) |
| The Reading shelf is a row, and it is packed tight (282) | the Reading shelf lays its books in a row, and draws as many rows as it packed (813); on a manual shelf a plate opens what is under it, not the whole letter (958); a plaque sits under the books it names, in the same scroller (666) |
| A book is as thick as it is full (337) | a spine's thickness is its note count (1436) |
| An impossible date is not a date (367) | an impossible date is not a date, and never a fifteenth month (442) |
| Book addresses are stable across a rebuild (385) | book addresses are stable across a rebuild (1470) |
| Filters change membership and nothing else (391) | a filter changes membership without moving a shelf (1481) |
| A reorder of the shelves themselves survives the reload (401) | a reordered shelf survives a reload, on both hosts (1504) |
| A shelf arranged by hand moves nothing but the sequence (445) | a shelf arranged by hand keeps every address and starts where it stood (1598); Alt+Right moves a book one place, and it survives a rebuild and a reload (1631); a drag and drop moves a book the same way a key does, across rows (1672); saved reading order leaves an arranged shelf alone (1736); a book nobody has arranged stands at the end of the shelf (1772); a filter narrows an arranged shelf without shuffling it (1800) |
| The Favourites shelf holds references, and only references (492) | Favourites comes first and empty, fresh and by migration from schema 9 (1840); a drop onto Favourites adds the book where it landed, and a rebuild keeps it (1906); a favourite comes off by the menu, and a dead pick is dropped on save and not before (2066); a favourite dragged off the shelf comes off, and a cancelled drag does not (2145); a second favourites shelf is built from the builder and holds its own books (2258); a note in two favourites is one note on the shelf (2359); a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (404) |
| A book made on the shelf is a saved query, and a place a note lives (567) | a book made on the shelf holds the notes it points at, where it was made (2390); a look is opt-in, repaints everything and moves nothing (4314); also shelved in moves to another book and keeps the note (8238); a made book is edited, emptied and deleted from its own menu, and the vault does not move (2613); a book is made on any shelf arranged by hand, and a plus stands where the books end (2769) |
| The room parts, the twelve are offered, and the thread is tonal (627) | — no check named in the section |
| A hovered swatch paints the room, and leaving puts it back (705) | a hovered swatch paints the room, and leaving puts it back (3672) |
| A right-click dyes a book, a plate's run or a shelf (810) | a right-click dyes a book, a plate's run or a shelf, and hovering paints it first (3912) |
| A shelf can be deleted, placed and carried (861) | — no check named in the section |
